author: Punalama
body:
I was banned from the server a year ago because of using bettersprint and click-aimbot. My name was F4LCONK at that time. I loved playing this server and it was my first multiplayer server. A friend of mine logged in my account to try a new hack that he created. Unfortunately he tried it on this server and when he learned that he was banned he changed my password. I was very sad to hear that I was banned. I learned this 2 days ago. I changed my passwords and everything and I am sure that it will never happen again.
 If you unban me I would be the happiest guy in the world. Please dont sperate me and my favorite server.

 Thank you for your attention.

 Sincerely,

Punalama (F4LCONK)
